sentences.text: No, paragraph 261(2)(ii) is in the Urban Co-operative Banks Directions, which state that they apply to all Urban Co-operative Banks, not commercial banks.
For commercial banks, the relevant Directions are the Commercial Banks Responsible Business Conduct Directions, which state that they apply to Commercial Banks.
The UCB pre-payment-charge rule in paragraph 261(2)(ii) therefore does not bind a commercial bank like yours.
